SELECT s.id AS sentence_id, v.zh AS zh, v.level AS level, s.status AS status, r.state AS review_state, r.due_at AS review_due_at FROM sentences s JOIN sentence_banks b ON b.id = s.bank_id JOIN sentence_versions v ON v.id = s.current_version_id LEFT JOIN reviews r ON r.sentence_id = s.id AND r.user_id = #{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT} WHERE s.bank_id = #{bankId}
ORDER BY s.created_at ASC, s.id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sentences s JOIN sentence_banks b ON b.id = s.bank_id JOIN sentence_versions v ON v.id = s.current_version_id WHERE s.bank_id = #{bankId}
